newsitem.title: USA: FirstFederal to become a bank holding co.
newsitem.headline: FirstFederal to become a bank holding co.

text.p: FirstFederal Financial Services Corp said on Tuesday that it has received approval from the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland to become a bank holding company.
FirstFederal said expects to begin operating as a bank holding company in July.

FirstFederal Financial Services Corp is the holding company for two financial services companies: Mobile Consultants Inc., a broker and servicer of manufactured housing finance contracts and First Federal Savings and Loan Association of Wooster with 20 banking offices in the north central Ohio counties of Wayne, Ashland, Medina, Richland and Knox.
